metrics.scope: NumPy64 scored native160. CFA/ROI repetitions average within source before equal-source means. Local band pools CFA/ROI blocks within source; repeated/overlapping blocks add no independent sources. Reference noise may contribute to fine bands; these measure reference recovery, not exact scene-detail recovery.

native_review.scope: All20 contexts, three conditions, RGGB native boards; numerical scoring includes four CFAs. Fine grass, rail grain, mortar, trees and lettering substantially clearer than RawNIND. High-noise grass/foliage remain soft. Joint versions differ subtly; no clear qualitative V119 breakthrough. References retain noise/optics and are not exact scene GT.

limitations: 11 held-out captures, not 240 independent photos; added declared noise and binned reference estimates are not real high-ISO validation or universal camera/place generalization. Original960 joint predictions and failed receipts preserved byte-for-byte.
